animation_styles.description: Animation styles to generate (for standard video_producer)

fps.description: Speed parameter (seconds per period for bar_race, frames per second for others) ex 1.0 = 12 sec, 2.0=22 sec , 2.5,3.0=27,33 sce,

use_existing_csv.description: Use existing CSV instead of generating new one

video_enabled.description: Enable standard video generation (uses smart_video_tool with multiple animation styles)

bar_race_video_enabled.description: Enable amazing bar race video generation (NEW - uses bar_race_video_tool with professional interpolation)
bar_race_video_enabled.note: Set to true to generate amazing smooth bar race animations instead of standard videos. Can be used WITH or WITHOUT video_enabled.
